text:
Sixty-six kilograms at nearly forty kilometres an hour.

And the rule that matters most. Nobody stands under a triangle on its way up. Dropped from the top of the hoist, 6.1 metres, a 66 kilogram triangle lands at 39 kilometres an hour, with 4.0 kilojoules. Mark a ring under the hook and keep it empty. Wear a helmet. Climb on a proper climbing system, tied in twice, or hire an arborist for the ties. The web is only as safe as the worst knot in it.
